medicines: Paracetamol oral suspension 120 mg/5 ml: give 7.5 ml, up to 4 times in 24 hours, at least 4 hours between doses
Oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) can be used
dates: Diarrhoea usually stops within 5 to 7 days
actions: Give small amounts of fluid often: 5 ml every 5 minutes if vomiting, then more as she keeps it down
Keep breastfeeding or giving her usual milk
Bring Lina back or call 111 if fewer than 4 wet nappies in 24 hours, very sleepy, blood in her poo, or cannot keep any fluids down
Call 999 if she is hard to wake up
negatives: Do not give anti-diarrhoea medicines to your child

notes: Dose must stay 7.5 ml of the 120 mg/5 ml suspension; mixing up ml and mg is a dosage error. Drafted by Claude (Opus 5.5) from the letter text, at the author's request; awaiting review by the project author.
